name: Aphelia
notes: Your tabs are safe: Aphelia now reopens all your tabs, pins, folders and Spaces after a restart, an update or a crash, and keeps automatic backups of your last 40 sessions. Closing a tab no longer jumps to another Space: you stay in the Space, or see its Home when it was the last tab. Tabs kept from a Glance or a web app panel are saved right away. The taskbar and Start menu now show the new Aphelia icon.
